name: @xrpl-commons/xrpl-connect-privy
description: Framework-independent Privy social login and embedded XRPL wallets for XRPL Connect
author: XRPL Connect Contributors

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const { npm_config_tag: tag, npm_config_access: access, npm_config_registry: registry, npm_package_version: version } = process.env; const expectedTag = /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+-rc\.\d+$/.test(version) ? 'rc' : /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(version) ? 'release' : ''; let registryUrl = ''; try { registryUrl = new URL(registry).href; } catch {} if (!expectedTag || tag !== expectedTag || access !== 'public' || registryUrl !== 'https://registry.npmjs.org/') { console.error('Publish requires the version-matched rc/release tag, --access public, and --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/'); process.exit(1); }"
